summary_ja: 筑波大学の現行system portfolioへ、2026年3月27日運用開始のSiriusを追加しました。24 nodeのSiriusは各nodeにMI300Aを4基搭載し、CPU、GPU、HBM3を同一packageへ統合します。既存のPegasus、共同運営Miyabiと合わせると、離散GPU、大規模GH200、CPU-only、統合memory APUを使い分ける構成です。次期整備ではpeak性能ではなくworkload routingとdata/software移行を含めて評価する必要があります。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: Sirius, in service since March 27, 2026, was added to the University of Tsukuba's current system portfolio. Its 24 nodes each contain four MI300A APUs integrating CPU, GPU, and HBM3 in one package. Together with Pegasus and jointly operated Miyabi, the portfolio spans discrete GPUs, large-scale GH200, CPU-only, and unified-memory APU resources. Future planning must evaluate workload routing and data/software migration rather than peak performance alone. Consensus is incomplete.

items.name_ja: SiriusはMI300A統合メモリ型の小規模高密度system
items.name_en: Sirius is a compact high-density MI300A unified-memory system
items.statement_ja: Sirius（PACS12.0）は24 nodeで、各nodeにAMD Instinct MI300A APUを4基搭載します。各APUは24-core EPYC CPU、122.6 TFLOPSの倍精度CDNA 3 GPU、128 GB HBM3を同一packageへ統合し、node当たり4本・計1.6 TbpsのInfiniBand NDRで接続します。全体の理論peakは11.9 PFLOPSです。公開資料だけでは実application性能、共有HBMの競合、消費電力、利用率は確認できません。
items.statement_en: Sirius (PACS12.0) has 24 nodes with four AMD Instinct MI300A APUs per node. Each APU integrates a 24-core EPYC CPU, a 122.6-TFLOPS double-precision CDNA 3 GPU, and 128 GB of HBM3 in one package; each node has four InfiniBand NDR links totaling 1.6 Tbps. System theoretical peak is 11.9 PFLOPS. Public material does not yet establish application performance, contention in shared HBM, power consumption, or utilization.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 統合メモリAPUを、CPU/GPU分離nodeとは異なる移植性・data movement・小規模strong-scalingの検証基盤として評価できます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: The unified-memory APU can be evaluated as a testbed for portability, data movement, and compact strong scaling distinct from discrete CPU-GPU nodes.
adoption_conditions_ja: Miyabi-GおよびPegasusとの同一application比較を行う。
CPU/GPU双方からのHBM利用時の帯域・容量競合を測る。
node電力とjob-level energyを公開・比較する。
adoption_conditions_en: Run matched application comparisons against Miyabi-G and Pegasus.
Measure bandwidth and capacity contention when CPU and GPU share HBM.
Publish and compare node power and job-level energy.

items.name_ja: Pegasus・Sirius・Miyabiは同一センター内の相補的資源
items.name_en: Pegasus, Sirius, and Miyabi are complementary resources
items.statement_ja: 筑波大学の現行資源は、H100 PCIe・DDR5・不揮発性memoryを持つPegasus 150 node、MI300A統合memoryのSirius 24 node、JCAHPC共同運営でGH200 1,120 nodeとXeon Max 190 nodeからなるMiyabiです。これは単一巨大systemではなく、memory構成、accelerator結合、規模、運営主体の異なるportfolioです。
items.statement_en: Tsukuba's current resources comprise 150 Pegasus nodes with H100 PCIe, DDR5, and persistent memory; 24 Sirius nodes with MI300A unified memory; and jointly operated JCAHPC Miyabi with 1,120 GH200 nodes and 190 Xeon Max nodes. This is a portfolio differing in memory organization, accelerator coupling, scale, and operating authority rather than one monolithic system.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 次期HPCIではcenterごとのpeak値だけでなく、workload routing、software image、data共有、accountingを跨いだportfolioとして容量を設計すべきです。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Future HPCI capacity should be designed as a portfolio spanning workload routing, software environments, data sharing, and accounting, not merely as center peak values.
adoption_conditions_ja: 三system間の利用者・queue・job特性を同一定義で集計する。
softwareとdatasetの移行経路を明示する。
JCAHPC共同運営分と筑波単独運営分の責任境界を記録する。
adoption_conditions_en: Aggregate users, queues, and job characteristics across the three systems under common definitions.
Document software and dataset migration paths.
Record responsibility boundaries between jointly operated JCAHPC and Tsukuba-operated resources.
